resources.string: Off: the keyboard opens only when you tap a text field

When it is off, pages and apps that focus a text field by themselves no longer pop the keyboard up. Some apps ask for it as if you had tapped and may still open it. Back hides it as usual; tap the field to bring it back.
While the keyboard is open, the volume buttons move the cursor one step (hold to repeat) instead of changing the volume. Closing the keyboard gives the buttons back.
